title: Comunicado 2025-08-07
summary: Banxico's Board cut the policy rate 25bp to 7.75% by a 4-1 majority, with Heath again dissenting for a hold at 8.00%, and kept the guidance that it 'valorará recortes adicionales' while weighing all the determinants of inflation. Versus the 26 June communique, the guidance text is unchanged but the pace halved from 50bp to 25bp, so the easing signal is still continuity of the cycle, only slower. The justification stays dovish (peso behavior, weak activity with persistent slack, trade-policy impacts, the degree of restriction already in place), while the inflation read is mixed: headline fell to 3.51% on the non-core component, but core edged up to 4.23%, short-term core forecasts were revised up and the balance of risks keeps an upside bias, albeit less pronounced than in 2021-2024. The persistent dissent and the downshift in pace keep this a cut with a moderating, rather than accelerating, easing bias.

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno del Banco de México decidió disminuir en 25 puntos base el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día a un nivel de 7.75%
key_quotes.context: 25bp cut, half the 50bp size of the June move

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno valorará recortes adicionales a la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Forward guidance unchanged: further cuts will be assessed

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza, si bien este es menos pronunciado que el enfrentado entre 2021 y 2024.
key_quotes.context: Upside tilt to inflation risks retained, though milder than in the post-pandemic period

key_quotes.quote: Votó a favor de mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en un nivel de 8.00% Jonathan Heath.
